title: Review columns: reviews, maintenance, rule review
goal: Columns 2 to 4: every periodic review, the maintenance review and the rule review show last and next
acceptance: Column 2: architecture (including outside-landscape), token and rule-load, skills, map and push reviews, each last and next from reviews.<name>.days
Column 3: maintenance review last and next from its receipt
Column 4: friction count and periodic rule consolidation, last and next
Each cell links to its evidence file; a review kind a project does not configure reads "not configured", a configured one with no evidence reads never run
Fixtures, committed failing first: one per column group with current, due and never-run cases
privacy: Fixtures are invented repositories, manifests and API responses; no personal data, no real alert content.
escalation: A change to how an existing table, gap kind or evidence file behaves goes back to the owner
A source that cannot be read without a new token scope or a project edit is reported unknown, never worked around

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: the review reader exists; maintenance and friction evidence are read, not computed. Not a measurement.
